lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for adoption hint, adoption new flow, choose path hint, and home notifications, as each has only 1 test.
Path layout changes (choose_path, layout) can be helpful, yielding 1 winning test across 4 tests.
Finish new screen changes (finish, new_screen) can be helpful, producing 1 winning test across 4 tests (though 1 test performed significantly worse).
Sign-in hint changes (sign_in, hint) can be helpful, producing 1 winning test across 4 tests.
Home wait info changes (home, wait_info) and adoption redesign changes (adoption, redesign) showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Predictions were generally overly optimistic, but underpredicted winning tests in Round 2 (path layout) and Round 3 (finish new screen).

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Split Overview Layout
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate step into a split layout presenting pet traits alongside official adoption details.
candidates.why: Adoption is the biggest funnel bottleneck with only 60.9% conversion, showing users stall while reviewing adoption details.

adoption_certificate.headline: Review & Confirm Pet Adoption Details
adoption_certificate.body: Verify your pet's attributes and name before finalizing adoption.

guard.reason: Redesigning the certificate layout while retaining official adoption details is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Targets biggest bottleneck, but adoption redesigns averaged -0.5% in past tests.

candidates.title: Deferred Account Sign-In Order
candidates.change: Move sign-in to take place right before final home setup instead of before selecting and customizing a pet.
candidates.why: Sign-in currently happens before pet selection; moving it later lets users form an emotional bond with their pet first.

guard.reason: Moving the sign-in step within onboarding while retaining all required steps is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Good logic for emotional connection, but flow reordering requires significant release effort.

candidates.title: Desktop Controls Quick Start Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated summary screen before finish detailing desktop tray shortcuts and pet interaction commands.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple tickets (3 emails) from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup.

new_controls_summary.headline: Quick Desktop Controls
new_controls_summary.body: Learn how to summon, minimize, and talk to your pet on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adding a controls summary screen within onboarding is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Strong support mail alignment, but past finish new screens averaged -2.5% lift.

candidates.title: Custom Pet Style Selection Flow
candidates.change: Insert a style picker screen during custom pet adoption so users can select rendering styles before generation.
candidates.why: Support receives 3 emails about custom pet rendering failures or visual misconfiguration, hurting adoption conversion (60.9%).

new_pet_style_picker.headline: Select Pet Rendering Style
new_pet_style_picker.body: Choose how your custom pet renders on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adding a style picker sub-flow during custom pet adoption is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Addresses support complaints and bottleneck, but extra flow step previously degraded adoption.

candidates.title: Desktop Renderer Launch Time Info
candidates.change: Enable time estimates and explicit progress indicators on the waiting screen during desktop pet loading.
candidates.why: Home waiting stage has a long mean duration of 2336s (median 201s), causing user drop-off due to uncertain wait times.

waiting.headline: Initializing Desktop Pet Renderer
waiting.body: Setting up graphics assets and desktop integration...

guard.reason: Displaying time estimates and progress for a real wait period is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Funnel shows long wait times, but home wait info showed negligible gain in past tests.

candidates.title: Story Screen Scroll Showcase Layout
candidates.change: Switch the introductory story screen layout to story_scroll to highlight key pet behaviors upfront.
candidates.why: Path selection has a high mean time of 514s, indicating users take a long time to understand app capabilities before deciding.

story.headline: Meet Your New Desktop Companion
story.body: Discover how your pet lives, plays, and assists right on your desktop screen.

guard.reason: Redesigning the story layout while continuing to introduce the pet is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Path duration is high and path layout changes yielded +1.4% avg lift across 4 tests.

candidates.title: Sign-In Pet Profile Sync Notice
candidates.change: Display a explicit reassurance hint on sign-in clarifying that logging in preserves existing pet data.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing back in, creating friction during sign-in.

sign_in.hint: Signing in ensures your pet settings and profile stay saved across desktop restarts.

guard.reason: Adding a profile sync reassurance hint on sign-in is allowed.

candidates.score_note: 8 support emails directly support this change, and sign-in hints have positive track record.

candidates.title: Clear Path Selection Choice Copy
candidates.change: Update headline and body on choose_path to explicitly contrast instant pre-made adoption vs photo customization.
candidates.why: Mean time on choose_path is 514s, showing hesitation due to unclear path differences.

choose_path.headline: Choose How You Want to Adopt
choose_path.body: Pick a ready-to-go companion instantly or build a custom desktop pet from your own photo.

guard.reason: Asks for personal information (user's personal photo).

candidates.title: Desktop Tray Docking Ready Notification
candidates.change: Enable desktop readiness notifications on home_intro to confirm when the pet successfully launches into the system tray.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails about pets failing to appear on the desktop or launch cleanly upon completing onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Your Desktop Pet is Active!
home_intro.body: Look for your pet on screen or in the system tray to start interacting.

guard.reason: Enabling ready notifications on home intro is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Simple notification config toggle to resolve desktop launch confusion from support tickets.

candidates.title: Friend Selection Badge Highlight
candidates.change: Add highlight badges to pet options on pick_friend screen to guide pet selection.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel at 60.9%, needing stronger visual incentives.

guard.reason: Adding a playful popular badge to guidance options is allowed and fair.

candidates.score_note: Targeting main funnel drop-off with UI badge highlights to simplify choice.

lessons_next: Evidence is still thin for adoption hints, choose path hints, finish notifications, and home notifications, as each has only 1 test.

Path layout changes (choose_path, layout), finish new screen changes (finish, new_screen), and sign-in hint changes (sign_in, hint) can be helpful, each producing 1 winning test across multiple tests.
Home wait info changes (home, wait_info) and adoption redesign changes (adoption, redesign) showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Adoption new flow changes (adoption, new_flow) showed no clear positive effect across 2 tests, with 1 test performing significantly worse.
Predictions were generally overly optimistic overall, but underpredicted winning tests in path layout (Round 2) and finish new screen (Round 3).
